title: Return Volatility and Trading Volume: An Information Flow Interpretation of Stochastic Volatility
one_line: A microstructure model in which information arrival drives both volatility and volume (modified mixture-of-distributions) fits the data far better than the standard version and helps explain volatility clustering.

findings.statement: Modified MDH vastly outperforms the standard MDH.

why.pattern: Information flow drives volume and volatility together.

reported_results.headline: A microstructure model in which information arrival drives both volatility and volume (modified mixture-of-distributions) fits the data far better than the standard version and helps explain volatility clustering.

tradable_edge: No strategy; supports using volume (e.g. relative opening volume) as an information-arrival gauge.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 3), not by the weekly pipeline.
